Qualities of good mathematicians

An evidence-based list built from published interviews, profiles and biographies. It is part of a study of the qualities that can be seen and nurtured at school, for the Math Talent Search that Laura runs with Equitech Futures, and of a larger study with AIRSHIP on the motivation and qualities of scientists at every stage of life and career. Every number is computed from the audited database; every quote links to its source. Read the Method & limits before drawing conclusions, or the white paper.
